en.headline: Over 96 per cent of Wang Fuk Court owners accept government buyout
en.dek: Housing secretary Winnie Ho said 1,914 households had accepted the offer as of Thursday, with only about 70 still outstanding before the 31 August deadline.
body: More than 96 per cent of flat owners at the fire-ravaged Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po have accepted the government's acquisition offer, Housing secretary Winnie Ho said on Friday.

Writing on social media, Ho said 1,914 households, or 96.5 per cent, had submitted acceptance letters as of Thursday. The number of owners who had not yet returned their letters had fallen to about 70, down from more than 100 earlier in the week.

She encouraged the remaining owners to sign and submit their letters before the 5 p.m. deadline on 31 August, warning that those who miss it would lose the chance to join the government's long-term housing arrangements for the estate.

The Housing Bureau will conduct computer random sorting in batches for participants in the special sales exercise, based on replies received by 30 June and by 31 August. Sale arrangements are expected to proceed next month, with owners notified of sorting results by post and invited to select flats in daily batches of about 50 to 80 households starting by the end of September.

zh.headline: 宏福苑逾96%業主接受政府收購 尚餘約70戶未回覆
zh.dek: 房屋局局長何永賢表示，截至周四有1,914戶業主接受收購，距離8月31日截止期限尚餘約70戶。
body: 大埔宏福苑火災受影響屋苑逾96%業主已接受政府收購要約，房屋局局長何永賢周五表示。
何永賢在社交平台發文指，截至周四已有1,914戶業主交回接納書，佔總數96.5%。尚未回覆的業主由周一超過100戶降至約70戶。
她呼籲餘下業主在8月31日下午5時截止期限前簽署並交回接納書，否則將錯失參與政府為宏福苑提供的長遠住屋安排機會。
房屋局稍後會按6月30日及8月31日接獲回覆的批次，為參與特別銷售計劃的業主以電腦隨機抽籤排序。銷售安排預計下月展開，當局將以郵遞通知業主抽籤結果，並由9月底起分批邀請每日約50至80戶揀樓。
